about.title: About Crest
about.intro: Crest for Agricultural Development is based in Alexandria, Egypt, and exports fresh, frozen and dried agricultural products.
about.imageAlt: Citrus orchards in the Nile Delta
about.story: Crest for Agricultural Development is an Alexandria-based export desk focused on connecting Egyptian agricultural products with international buyers. We coordinate product selection, specifications, packing discussions and shipment planning around each enquiry.
about.vision: To build lasting trade relationships by making Egyptian produce easier to source, specify and receive across international markets.
about.mission: We work with buyers to clarify product requirements, communicate openly about availability and coordinate export preparation from origin to destination.

items.question: Which products and forms can I request?
items.answer: Our range includes fresh, frozen and dried products. Available forms vary by crop and season; share your requirement and we will confirm what can be discussed.

items.question: When is a product available?
items.answer: Fresh crop windows are seasonal and may shift with variety and growing conditions. Frozen and dried availability depends on the product programme. Contact us for current availability.

items.question: Can packaging carry my brand?
items.answer: Private-label options can be discussed. Share your artwork, pack format and destination needs so our team can review the requirements.

items.question: How do I receive pricing and shipping details?
items.answer: Send your product, specification, destination and estimated quantity. Pricing, shipping options and timing depend on the product and destination; our sales team will confirm.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: We collect the details you submit through the inquiry form: name, company, country, contact details, product, requested quantity and message. The page and language are attached to the inquiry for context. If you choose WhatsApp or email, we record that channel choice.
privacy.use: We use these details only to review and reply to your inquiry.
privacy.contact: For questions about your inquiry details, contact info@crestagricultural.com.
